claude_proposed_widenings.name: on_miss_trigger
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Graze fires when the attack roll misses, not when it hits. MasteryMechanics = OnHitTriggerMechanics is the only family; there is no on_miss_trigger mastery family. A new family (or a new trigger variant on OnHitTriggerMechanics) is required to represent the miss path.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If your attack roll misses a creature, you can deal damage to that creature equal to the ability modifier you used to make the attack roll.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: DiceAmount { kind: 'ability_modifier' }
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Graze damage equals the ability modifier used for the attack — a scalar, not a dice expression. DiceAmount only supports fixed/threshold_tiers/linear_per_level, all of which require a DiceExpr base. An ability_modifier variant is needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: you can deal damage to that creature equal to the ability modifier you used to make the attack roll

claude_proposed_widenings.name: DamageType { kind: 'weapon_damage_type' }
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Graze damage type is 'same as the weapon's damage', not a fixed closed-enum string. DamageType is a string union of 13 concrete types; no variant expresses weapon-relative type inheritance.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: This damage is the same type as the weapon's damage
